findings.text: follow-on: _CODE_IMPORT_PROBE (reckon/mcp.py:272-280) and _import_root (reckon/mcp.py:284) duplicate the follower's throwaway-interpreter probe (reckon/crew_follow_commands.py:166-172) and import-root helper (reckon/crew_follow_commands.py:148) rather than extending the owner — the same compile-every-module-then-import capability in a second implementation, so a fix to one probe will not reach the other.

item_verdicts.call_sites: the five production tool registrations in reckon/mcp.py route every incoming call through _refuse_when_stale.
item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against e717ee432; 203882d19 added the guard (stamp checked before every call) and f591f7211 reworked it to act only on a failed call, wrapping the five registered tools in reckon/mcp.py:2950-2980.
item_verdicts.done_when: the EVIDENCE fence is asserted by the three tests in tests/test_mcp_server_serves_current_code.py and recorded in gate.log (200 passed, EXIT=0) against base-arm.log (197 passed, EXIT=0).
item_verdicts.goal: the source node goal is to make a reckon MCP server say its imported code no longer matches its checkout, with the reconnect remedy; reckon/mcp.py:312 _stale_code_response returns that refusal when the stamp has moved.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, it names the head f591f7211, gate.log 200 passed / base-arm.log 197 passed, the red negative_control.log (1 failed, EXIT=1) and the follow_on about the stamp not covering reckon/_flight_schema.py; its commits list names only f591f7211 and omits the superseded 203882d19 the head rewrites.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the node declares reckon/mcp.py, reckon/mcp_views.py, tests/test_mcp_server_serves_current_code.py; the diff e717ee432..f591f721 touches only reckon/mcp.py and the new test file.

justifications.durability: the negative control reddens tests/test_mcp_server_serves_current_code.py:200 when _stale_code_response's check is removed, and test 2 (line 213) reddens if the guard runs before the call; only server_started_at == payload['started_at'] (line 205) moves with the implementation.
justifications.evidence: gate.log records '200 passed in 141.62s' EXIT=0 at f591f72117 and base-arm.log '197 passed' EXIT=0 at e717ee432, delta +3 with no failure beyond base, and negative_control.log is red EXIT=1.
justifications.fit: the guard's names (_SERVER_CODE_STAMP, _refuse_when_stale, reckon/mcp.py:262-370) follow the module's leading-underscore idiom and carry no plan label, version or ticket reference.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/mcp.py:312 _stale_code_response names the start time, the change and the reconnect remedy when follower_code_stamp() differs from the import-time _SERVER_CODE_STAMP (reckon/mcp.py:263).
justifications.reuse: the stamp is extended from its owner follower_code_stamp (reckon/crew/follower_registration.py:51) as the brief requires, but _import_root (reckon/mcp.py:284) and _CODE_IMPORT_PROBE (reckon/mcp.py:272) duplicate reckon/crew_follow_commands.py:148 and :166 rather than extending them.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat e717ee432..f591f721 lists only reckon/mcp.py and tests/test_mcp_server_serves_current_code.py, both inside the declared paths.
